title: Analord Squelch Vigil
prompt: aphex twin | Energy: dense/driving. Register focus: chord-led acid. Palette: RolandTR909 + a characterful acid line. Tempo: 128 BPM. Arc shape: slow-burn build. Mood modifier: hypnotic, gritty, Analord-acid.
description: A slow-burning Analord-style acid workout: gritty TR-909 four-on-the-floor locks under off-beat chord stabs that morph into a resonant, distorted squelch line. Over four minutes the filter cracks open, the progression rotates through four dub-minor chords, and ratcheting transforms keep the hypnosis gritty and alive.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
arrange(

    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.0),

    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.55).room(0.3),

  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.1),

    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(900).resonance(12).shape(0.3).room(0.6).delay(".5:.125:.6").gain(0.5),

    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.6).room(0.25),
